name: OKC_XPRT_RULE_HDRS_ALL
description: This table has the rule header information for template specific rules as well as rules assigned at all templates in the Operating Unit

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: INTENT
columns.description: Rule intent. B: Buy or S: Sell

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the status of the Rule and is applicable only to Organization Rules. FK to FND lookup OKC_XPRT_RULE_STATUSES.

columns.name: RULE_TYPE
columns.description: Identify the Rule Type Values: POLICY_DEVIATION and CLAUSE_SELECTION. FK to FND_LOOKUP 'OKC_XPRT_RULE_TYPE.

columns.name: LINE_LEVEL_FLAG
columns.description: Identify if the rule has any line level system variables. This column would be updated when the rules are activated.

columns.name: ORG_WIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the template is applicable to all templates in the current operating unit

columns.name: CONDITION_EXPR_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the conditions on the rule are 'Any True' or 'All True'. Possible values are 'ALL' or 'ANY'. FK to FND lookup OKC_XPRT_CONDITION_EXPRESSION.

columns.name: DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: HOLDS DEFAULT TEMPLATE VALUE FOR TEMPLATE SELECTION RULES

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
